customer_name: Huaqiaocheng Group Co., Ltd. (华侨城集团有限公司)
business_problem: Huaqiaocheng needed a unified compute and cloud-governance platform for more than 600 subsidiaries while also strengthening application, network, and data security with more intelligent controls that could satisfy state-owned-enterprise compliance requirements.
solution_summary: Huaqiaocheng worked with Huawei Cloud to build a dedicated multi-subsidiary cloud platform that combined the DeC dedicated cloud solution, CloudPond edge deployment, and a cloud-native security stack. DeC gave the group an isolated resource pool and unified O&M model so headquarters could provision compute centrally while subsidiaries used a consistent cloud environment. CloudPond extended cloud infrastructure and services into local machine rooms for latency-sensitive and data-locality workloads, letting core business data stay on premises while still joining centralized scheduling. Huawei layered in security cloud brain, situation awareness, Cloud Firewall, Web Application Firewall, Enterprise Host Security, and Database Security Service so security telemetry from group and subsidiary environments could be analyzed for posture, threat detection, event correlation, and automated emergency response.

solution_components.name: DeC dedicated cloud solution
solution_components.role: Provides the isolated dedicated-cloud resource pool and centralized provisioning model used across the group.

solution_components.name: CloudPond
solution_components.role: Extends cloud infrastructure and services into business sites for local, low-latency, and data-residency workloads.

solution_components.name: security cloud brain
solution_components.role: Provides the AI-assisted security-analysis foundation for posture monitoring, privacy computing, and model security.

solution_components.name: situation awareness
solution_components.role: Correlates asset status and events to detect threats, analyze incidents, and trigger emergency response.

solution_components.name: Cloud Firewall
solution_components.role: Protects cloud network boundaries for subsidiary and group workloads.

solution_components.name: Web Application Firewall
solution_components.role: Protects web-facing applications at very high traffic volumes.

solution_components.name: Enterprise Host Security
solution_components.role: Applies host-level protection and compliance controls to cloud workloads.

solution_components.name: Database Security Service
solution_components.role: Audits and protects databases to meet compliance and security requirements.

data_flow: Headquarters and subsidiary applications are provisioned into the DeC dedicated cloud, while low-latency and sensitive workloads run locally through CloudPond. Security logs, cloud-asset posture signals, and application and database events flow into security cloud brain and situation awareness, where AI-assisted analytics drive alarms, threat response, compliance checks, and continuous security operations.
integration_points: local machine rooms for core systems
cloud asset and security event feeds
business_outcome: The program gave Huaqiaocheng a unified group cloud with faster resource rollout, lower operating burden, and continuously monitored security controls that helped keep subsidiary services running while improving compliance readiness.
metrics: security evaluation pass time shortened by 40%
architecture_clues: Dedicated cloud and CloudPond create a distributed cloud model for headquarters and subsidiaries.
Core data can remain in local machine rooms while still using cloud services.
The security design uses a seven-layer defense model plus continuous security operations.
The platform mixes public-cloud-like experience with isolated dedicated resource pools.
